title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 3. Recognises the evolving nature of global security threats and emphasises the crucial role that diplomacy, development cooperation and arms control and disarmament play alongside military efforts in ensuring long-lasting international peace and security; notes that, in the past, diplomatic solutions have proven to be the most effective way of resolving conflicts and ensuring long-term peace and stability; underscores that sustainable global peace and stability cannot be achieved through military measures alone, but require comprehensive strategies that address the key drivers of instability, such as poverty and governance failures; stresses that the EU should focus on building strong, cooperative relationships with its neighbours and supporting their internal security, while respecting their sovereignty and promoting peace through mutual respect and dialogue;
